description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure AdoNet grain storage in Orleans hosting. It provides methods to add and configure AdoNet storage components using dependency injection.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods for IServiceCollection to add and configure AdoNet grain storage in Orleans.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage with default provider name, applying custom options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage with specified name and options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage as the default storage, with optional custom options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AdoNet grain storage with specified name, options, and internal registration of validators and options.
